encoding: base64 row-major MSB-first 1-bit, 8 bytes per row

descriptions.idle: Original sheep: independent blinks, gentle bobs and an occasional stretch.
descriptions.wake: Squished sleepers stretch upwards, yawn, then wake at different times.
descriptions.arrive: The arriving sheep walks in from the nearest edge; the other notices and waves.
descriptions.weather_rain: Droplets fall around them; both huddle beneath a tiny umbrella.
descriptions.weather_sun: A little sun appears; each sheep bounces happily.
descriptions.weather_cloud: A drifting cloud catches their attention.
descriptions.celebrate: Hooves up, elastic jumps, outline stars and hearts.
descriptions.birthday: A little cake and candle appear; the birthday sheep wears a party hat.
descriptions.sleep: Both settle into a wider, squishy sleeping shape, with floating Zs.
descriptions.wave: The original raised-hoof animation, with a delayed response.
descriptions.dance: Original side steps mixed with squash-and-stretch and a music note.
descriptions.bored: Half-lidded eyes, a slow slump and a tiny ellipsis.
descriptions.clap: Both briefly stretch in surprise; sparse sparkles drift away.
descriptions.launch: A pair of celebratory hops and small stars.
descriptions.sunset: A tiny sun sinks, then the sheep settle down.
descriptions.christmas: Sparse snowfall and little festive hats.
descriptions.thought: They pause, glance towards each other and a few dots appear.
descriptions.morph: A playful sequence: squash, stretch, inflate, settle — always returning to the original sheep.
